title: Agentiz Pipeline Spec
description: Stored in PipelineSpec.spec. Declares which agent roles run for a matched task, in what order, what happens when a stage fails, and what the pipeline does with the result once every stage succeeded. Tag matching lives on the PipelineSpec row (matchTags/isDefault), not in this document.

stages.description: Executed strictly in ascending `order`. Each stage receives the outputs of all previous stages as context.

hooks.description: Scripts run around the stages, in the same directory the agent works in. Values arrive as AGENTIZ_* environment variables, never substituted into the script text. Absent = nothing runs.

triggers.description: Events that start this pipeline. All events are disabled unless explicitly enabled.

humanComment.description: Start a run when a human adds a task-thread message. The message becomes the run's primary prompt.

hook.description: before runs after the working directory is ready and before the first stage. after runs once the stages are done and before the diff is collected, so what it writes is part of the proposed change; it also runs when a stage failed, with AGENTIZ_RUN_STATUS=failed.

interpreter.description: What executes the script. The worker adds the shebang and invokes the interpreter by absolute path, so the script cannot choose its own.

script.description: Source without a shebang line. Runs with the working directory as cwd.

timeoutSec.description: Wall-clock limit. On expiry the hook is killed and treated as a non-zero exit.

onFail.description: stop = a non-zero exit fails the run; continue = log it and carry on.

source.description: Where the run gets its code. Absent means repository, which is what every spec written before this field does: the project's git provider decides what the run sees. worker_workspace pins the run to one worker and runs it in a directory that already exists on that machine.

repositoryId.description: AgentRepository.id this pipeline works on. Must be linked to the same project. Required for worker_workspace + finalAction commit; otherwise absent means the repository the task came from.

branch.description: Branch the worker takes the code from. Absent = the repository's own default branch. Ignored for kind worker_workspace.

allowTaskOverride.description: Let a task override the branch through AgentTask.branchRef or a branch:<ref> tag.

workspace.description: Required when kind is worker_workspace. Only the named worker can claim the run, because only that machine has the directory. Names the directory with exactly one of workspaceKey or path — see the cross-field rules from agentiz.pipelineSpecSchema.

workspaceKey.description: Key of an entry in that worker's declared Workspaces list. The path is resolved at queue time, so correcting the path never invalidates the spec. Mutually exclusive with path.

path.description: Absolute path on the worker's machine, given directly by the spec instead of a declared workspaceKey. Mutually exclusive with workspaceKey.

createIfMissing.description: Only meaningful with path: create the directory if it does not exist, instead of failing. Ignored (and rejected) with workspaceKey.

order.description: Position in the sequence. Must be unique within the spec.

role.description: Display/log name of what this step does, e.g. investigate, decide, fix, commit.

agentRoleKey.description: AgentRole.key within the same project. Supplies prompt/model/tools for the stage.

model.description: Overrides the role's own model for this stage only. Absent = the role's model (unchanged behaviour for every spec written before this field). Free-form: the executor resolves it, e.g. an Anthropic model id like claude-opus-5.

onFail.description: stop = fail the whole run; continue = mark this stage failed and run the next one.

runtime.description: OpenHands workspace placement. host runs the ACP agent in the worker process; docker starts an OpenHands Agent Server container through DockerWorkspace.

finalAction.description: What the run does after the last stage. commit_and_pr uses the hosting provider. commit on a managed worker_workspace stores a complete diff and queues commit/push on that same worker.

branch.description: Target branch for type commit. Defaults to the branch the run took its code from.

requireApproval.description: Hold the change in Agentiz instead of pushing it. The diff is stored either way; with this on the run ends in waiting_review and nothing reaches the repository until somebody applies it.

targetBranch.description: For worker_workspace commit: push the original branch or a new short branch.

branchPrefix.description: Branch name prefix for commit_and_pr. Final name is <branchPrefix><task.externalId>. Defaults to 'agentiz/'.
